name: Endou Suzune
source:
[url=/c73540]Endou Achi[/url]'s sister, who is hospitalized at Shibuya Central Hospital.

She suffers from a dilated cardiomyopathy heart disease and requires a heart transplant to survive. Her extremely rare Bombay Blood type makes finding a donor nearly impossible, and she is not expected to live long.
